description: Compatibility fixes for running Flashback on NeoForge 1.21.1 through Sinytra Connector.

mods.name: Flashback NeoForge Fixed
mods.description: Fixes for running the Flashback replay mod on NeoForge via Sinytra Connector.

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Fixes replay-created dimensions not ticking on NeoForge, restoring recorded head/body rotation and outer skin layers after dimension changes such as The Broken Script's Backrooms, the Nether, and other modded dimensions.
- Clears stale recorded entity pose caches when seeking, preventing replacement replay entities from becoming visually stuck after rewind or fast-forward.
- Treats Flashback's in-process replay connection like an integrated-server connection during Cobblemon data sync, avoiding redundant registry payloads and related failures in large Cobblemon extensions such as Lost Lore.

For Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge and Sinytra Connector.

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Fixes Cobblemon replay riding so recorded players stay seated on Pokémon with passenger state applied in recorded packet order.
- Prevents Cobblemon interaction menus and recorded party references from capturing replay input or failing during playback.
- Restores PowerGrid wire entities by snapshotting and applying their complete replay state.
- Repairs Connector payload codec lookup on newer NeoForge versions to prevent Fabric payload disconnects.
- Improves entity-target detection for Kotlin and other modded payloads.

For Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge and Sinytra Connector.

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Restores Immersive Vehicles entities in replays by preserving and replaying their full handshake state.
- Keeps Copycats materials and Create kinetic animations correct across startup, rewind, and fast-forward.
- Uses an indexed, disk-backed replay chunk cache to reduce memory spikes, stalls, and cache corruption in large modpacks.
- Isolates malformed third-party block-entity data and deferred payload failures instead of crashing playback.
- Prevents replay-only side effects from recorded menus, advancements, Cobblemon spawning, and Essential emote state.

Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge / Sinytra Connector.

releases.notes:
New:

- Add Simple Voice Chat support. Flashback's voice-chat plugin is now registered with Simple Voice Chat's NeoForge loader automatically, so voice audio can be recorded and played back in replays.

**Voice recording must be enabled manually.** It is disabled by default. Before starting a recording, open `config/flashback/flashback.json` (the `config` folder is in the same directory as your `mods` folder) and set `"recordVoiceChat"` to `true`. Recordings made while this option is disabled do not contain any voice audio, and it cannot be recovered afterwards.

Fixes:

- Fix a Sodium chunk-builder crash when opening older replays containing Copycat Bytes and other multi-state Copycats blocks.

releases.notes:
Fixes:

- Preserve recorded modded custom-payload bytes exactly until the viewing client decodes them.
- Fix Cobblemon replay disconnects such as `Invalid species: cobblemon:totodile` after a lazy `species_sync` packet was re-encoded as an empty registry.
- Keep NeoForge advanced entity spawn handling and legacy replay safety checks intact.
- Apply the lossless forwarding path generically so other lazy or one-shot mod packet codecs do not suffer the same decode/re-encode corruption.
- Support affected existing recordings whose payload bytes were captured by earlier Flashback NeoForge Fixed releases.

mods.name: Flashback NeoForge Fixed
mods.description: Fixes for running the Flashback replay mod on NeoForge via Sinytra Connector.

releases.notes:
Fixes:

- Prevent Sable Cleanup's one-shot client UI packets from reopening screens or dialogs during replay playback and seeking, including older recordings.
- Avoid reapplying unchanged NeoForge registry snapshots on every seek, preventing transient block-state ID corruption and client disconnects in large modpacks.
- Recover the replay camera input grab automatically after the first replay finishes loading, without requiring two F1 presses.
- Keep Flashback's title-screen replay button and late-added small mod buttons from sharing the same visual and click area.
- Resolve pause-menu recording-control collisions while preserving normal layouts; colliding side buttons move to a free slot on their right.
- Handle late and render-time button layout changes from mods such as Create: Tweaked Controllers and FancyMenu.
